## Agenda Items
## 1. Budget Discussion
Throughout the month of June, the City Council reviewed the City Manager's proposed budget line-by-line. This is a chance for the City Council to see where the City Manager wants to spend money. At the meeting on 7/13, the council voted on the largest piece of the budget, the school. Tonight I expect us to finalize discussion and pass a budget for public hearing.
